pairs: In anno primo Darii filii Assueri de semine Medorum,
In the first year of Darius, the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes,
who ruled over the kingdom of the Chaldeans,
in year one of his reign,
ego Daniel intellexi in libris numerum annorum,
I, Daniel, understood in the books the number of the years,
de quo factus est sermo Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam,
concerning the word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah, the prophet,
ut complerentur desolationis Jerusalem septuaginta anni.
that the desolation of Jerusalem would be completed in seventy years.
Et posui faciem meam ad Dominum Deum meum rogare et deprecari in jejuniis,
And I set my face to the Lord, my God, to ask and make supplication with fasting,
And I prayed to the Lord,
preserving the covenant and mercy for those who love you and keep your commandments.
et declinavimus a mandatis tuis ac judiciis.
and we have turned aside from your commandments as well as your judgments.
We have not obeyed your servants,
qui locuti sunt in nomine tuo regibus nostris,
the prophets, who have spoken in your name to our kings,
and all the people of the land.
but to us is confusion of face,
just as it is on this day for the men of Judah,
et his qui procul in universis terris,
and those who are far off,
ad quas ejecisti eos propter iniquitates eorum,
in all the lands to which you have driven them,
because of their iniquities by which they have sinned against you.
to us belongs confusion of face:
Tibi autem Domino Deo nostro misericordia et propitiatio,
But to you, the Lord our God, is mercy and atonement,
for we have withdrawn from you,
et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri ut ambularemus in lege ejus,
and we have not listened to the voice of the Lord, our God, so as to walk in his law,
quam posuit nobis per servos suos prophetas.
which he established for us by his servants, the prophets.
Et omnis Israël prævaricati sunt legem tuam,
And all Israel has transgressed your law and has turned away,
et declinaverunt ne audirent vocem tuam:
not listening to your voice, and so the condemnation and the curse,
et stillavit super nos maledictio et detestatio quæ scripta est in libro Moysi servi Dei,
which is written in the book of Moses, servant of God, has rained down upon us,
because we have sinned against him.
And he has fulfilled his words,
quos locutus est super nos et super principes nostros,
which he has spoken over us
and over our leaders who judged us,
ut superinduceret in nos magnum malum,
that he would lead over us a great evil,
quale numquam fuit sub omni cælo,
such as has never before existed under all of heaven,
secundum quod factum est in Jerusalem.
according to what has been done in Jerusalem.
Sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi,
Just as it has been written in the law of Moses,
omne malum hoc venit super nos:
all this evil has come upon us,
and we did not entreat your face,
so that we might turn back from our iniquities
Et vigilavit Dominus super malitiam, et adduxit eam super nos.
And the Lord kept watch over the evil and has led it over us; the Lord,
Justus Dominus Deus noster in omnibus operibus suis,
our God, is just in all his works, which he has accomplished,
quæ fecit: non enim audivimus vocem ejus.
for we have not listened to his voice.
And now, O Lord, our God,
qui eduxisti populum tuum de terra Ægypti in manu forti, et fecisti tibi nomen secundum diem hanc:
who has led your people out of the land of Egypt with a strong hand and has made yourself a name in accordance with this day:
et furor tuus a civitate tua Jerusalem,
your anger and your fury from your city,
because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers,
et populus tuus in opprobrium sunt omnibus per circuitum nostrum.
Jerusalem and your people are a reproach to all who surround us.
orationem servi tui, et preces ejus:
the prayer of your servant and his requests,
et ostende faciem tuam super sanctuarium tuum,
and reveal your face over your sanctuary,
which is desolate, for your own sake.
aperi oculos tuos, et vide desolationem nostram, et civitatem super quam invocatum est nomen tuum:
open your eyes and see our desolation and the city over which your name is invoked.
neque enim in justificationibus nostris prosternimus preces ante faciem tuam,
For it is not through our justifications that we offer requests before your face,
but through the fullness of your compassion.
quia nomen tuum invocatum est super civitatem
because your name is invoked over your city and over your people.”
Cumque adhuc loquerer, et orarem, et confiterer peccata mea,
And while I was still speaking and praying and confessing my sins,
and the sins of my people, Israel,
et prosternerem preces meas in conspectu Dei mei, pro monte sancto Dei mei:
and offering my prayers in the sight of my God, on behalf of the holy mountain of my God,
as I was still speaking in prayer,
quem videram in visione a principio,
whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning,
cito volans tetigit me in tempore sacrificii vespertini.
flying swiftly, touched me at the time of the evening sacrifice.
and he spoke to me and said, “Now,
nunc egressus sum ut docerem te, et intelligeres.
I have come forth to teach you and to help you understand.
Ab exordio precum tuarum egressus est sermo:
At the beginning of your prayers,
ego autem veni ut indicarem tibi,
yet I have come to explain it to you because you are a man who is seeking.
you must pay close attention to the message and understand the vision.
Septuaginta hebdomades abbreviatæ sunt super populum tuum et super urbem sanctam tuam,
Seventy weeks of years are concentrated on your people and on your holy city,
so that transgression shall be finished,
and sin shall reach an end,
and iniquity shall be wiped away,
and so that everlasting justice shall be brought in,
and vision and prophecy shall be fulfilled,
and the Saint of saints shall be anointed.
from the going forth of the word to build up Jerusalem again,
there will be seven weeks of years,
and the wide path will be built again,
Et post hebdomades sexaginta duas occidetur christus:
And after sixty-two weeks of years, the Christ leader will be slain.
et non erit ejus populus qui eum negaturus est.
And the people who have denied him will not be his.
Et civitatem et sanctuarium dissipabit populus cum duce venturo:
And the people, when their leader arrives, will destroy the city and the sanctuary.
And its end will be devastation,
et post finem belli statuta desolatio.
and, after the end of the war, the desolation will be set up.
Confirmabit autem pactum multis hebdomada una:
But he will confirm a covenant with many for one week of years;
et in dimidio hebdomadis deficiet hostia et sacrificium:
and for half of the week of years, victim and sacrifice will nearly cease;
et erit in templo abominatio desolationis:
but there will be in the temple the abomination of desolation.
et usque ad consummationem et finem perseverabit desolatio.
And the desolation will continue even to the consummation and the end.”
